newsitem.title: USA: Compuserve defends ouster of Time.
newsitem.headline: Compuserve defends ouster of Time.

text.p: CompuServe Inc said Wednesday, in response to a lawsuit filed against it by Time Warner Inc, that Time Magazine's online content has not proved sufficient to justify its presence on CompuServe's Interactive Service.
The company, which has moved to terminate Time's presence there, said there was an exit option at the midpoint of its two-year contract with Time, which began on March 9, 1996.
The company said Time's assertion that CompuServe was reneging on its agreement is without merit and that it acted within the terms of its contract.
Time said earlier Wednesday that it is suing CompuServe for $3.5 million for removing it from its service and refusing to make payments to it.
